requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online without needing to call the clinic.
Patients must have secure access to test results after clinician authorization.
The portal must comply with GDPR and maintain data security.
The portal must be accessible for elderly patients and those who are not tech-savvy.
Patients must have a clear view of available time slots for GP and nurse appointments.
Patients must be able to filter appointment options based on appointment type.
The portal must allow patients to flag symptoms for same-day or emergency appointments.
Patients must be able to view a list of their current medications, including instructions.
Patients must be able to select multiple medications at once for repeat prescription requests.
The system must provide automated acknowledgment of prescription requests, including estimated timelines.
Access to test results must be granted only after clinician review and authorization.
Patients must see a summary of test results, including type, date, results, and reference ranges.
The portal must implement a secure identity verification process, potentially with multi-factor authentication.
Patients must be able to submit questions or requests for clarification regarding their test results through the portal.
The system must integrate with existing practice management software without requiring complete data migration.
The portal must accommodate varying levels of digital literacy among patients, especially the elderly.
The development of the portal must adhere to budget constraints.
Ongoing support and training must be provided for staff to manage the portal effectively.
